verdict.rationale: Luma documents image-to-video in its current Ray model, with character reference and keyframes, and lists I2V credit pricing. That covers the core of animating a still image. However, no first-party evidence states that the subject and composition of the source image are preserved. One hands-on commenter also reports morphing and a lack of real temporal coherence in generated motion. missing for 10: explicit documentation that I2V preserves subject and composition fidelity, independent hands-on confirmation of faithful image animation.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved
